name: Viggle
tagline: Viggle is an AI video tool that animates characters by merging a subject image with a reference motion video. Creators use it to put any character or person into a dance, walk, or action sequence by combining a still photo with a motion clip as reference. It gained popularity on social media for making meme characters and fictional figures perform real choreography.
